summary: [Parties] Capture off-platform entities and associate them with submissions
paragraphs: Outcome: a submitter can name an organization or individual not yet on the platform, provide required contact details, and preserve a durable unclaimed party and submission-role association without granting access.

End-to-end scope: required entity-kind/email contract -> safe persistence and candidate matching -> submission UI -> explicit invitation. Reuse authoritative organization/person/financial identity models; define adapters rather than creating a competing identity store. Definition of complete: all child acceptance criteria and staging evidence pass, no unresolved migration or privacy gaps.

Required contract slice under AIN-48 and unresolved-party boundary under AIN-59 are relevant but their broader finance work is not replaced. AIN-56/62/70/73/74 are existing reuse context, not proof of this new outcome. AIN-28/29/34/36/40/92 remain separate eligibility/financial mandates and settlement obligations.
